 NCAA D3 Football Playoff Bracket 2026: Full Field, First-Round Matchups
 The 2026 NCAA Division III football playoff bracket: all 40 teams, first-round matchups, automatic qualifiers, at-large bids and the road to the Stagg Bowl.
 Nov 15, 2026 by R. R. Ellis Christopher Newport vs. Susquehanna Football Highlights | 2026 D3 Football 4:31 The field is set for the 2026 NCAA Division III football playoffs, and nine unbeaten teams made it. Wheaton (Ill.), Saint John's (Minn.), UW-Whitewater, WashU, Cortland, Endicott, Baldwin Wallace, Calvin and Concordia Wisconsin all enter at 10-0.
 D2 Football Playoffs 2026: Watch The FloCollege Bracket Breakdown Monday 
 D2 Football Bracket Predictions: Final Projection Before Selection Sunday 
 D3 Football Scores: Three Unbeaten Top 25 Teams Fall Before Selection Sunday 
 Mount Union, the 13-time national champion, is not in the field. Neither are Salisbury and Chicago, even after both knocked off unbeaten teams on the final Saturday. Christopher Newport, the team Salisbury beat, did get in.
 Trinity (Conn.) made history as the NESCAC's first automatic qualifier and hosts RPI in the first round. Amherst and Wesleyan (Conn.) got in too, giving the NESCAC three teams in its first year of playoff eligibility.
 Twenty-four teams earned first-round byes. The eight first-round games kick off Saturday, Nov. 21.

 When Is The FloCollege D2 Football Bracket Breakdown? 
 FloCollege breaks down the full D2 bracket Monday, Nov. 16, at 1pm ET on the 2026 FloCollege D2 Football Bracket Breakdown .
 D3 Football Playoffs 2026 Schedule 
 First round: Saturday, Nov. 21
 Second round: Saturday, Nov. 28
 Third round: Saturday, Dec. 5
 Quarterfinals: Saturday, Dec. 12
 Semifinals: Saturday, Dec. 19
 Stagg Bowl: January 2027, Salem Stadium, Salem, Virginia
 When And Where Is The Stagg Bowl, The D3 Football National Championship? 
 The Stagg Bowl, the 2026 NCAA Division III football national championship game, is in January 2027 at Salem Stadium in Salem, Virginia. The game returns to its longtime home after stops in Houston and Canton, Ohio, the last two seasons.
 How Do The D3 Football Playoffs Work? 
 Forty teams make the field. Conference champions claim 29 automatic bids, and the selection committee fills the other 11 spots with at-large teams.
